notes: The appositional lamed of לְכָל הַצָּבָא was left holding only *for* while the *even* written beside it was marked `added`. The same explicative lamed takes the ASV's *even* in 2CH.26.12, and the same *even* + preposition expression is kept whole on the preposition in 2CH.26.8; no morpheme other than this lamed answers to the word here. The whole *even for* is that one morpheme's rendering under rule 30's one-rendering reading, headed on the relational word by rules 16 and 24.
